answers.core: Like above, it seems intuitive and doesn't make sense in my opinion to need a whole addon just for one (or maybe a few) functions. Giving easier access to the underlying data means less people running into limitations.
answers.workaround: Yes, but the performance might not be ideal, and it just seems intuitive for there to be more ways of selecting tile cells in code.

title: Add more functions for getting coordinate arrays from TileMapLayer like `get_used_cells_in_range(start: Vector2i, end: Vector2i)`
